subject.title: iOS app: node requests re-approval on every reconnect (token persistence bug)

question: Should this issue wait for real current-main iOS LAN/VPN reconnect proof before closure, or is the merged LAN bootstrap source fix sufficient to accept closure?
rationale: The source fix is a real partial repair, but the issue's central symptom is repeated node reapproval and current gateway source still has a separate reapproval path.

options.title: Require live iOS reconnect proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until an iPhone build pairs once, reconnects several times, and gateway status/logs show no new pending reapproval.

options.title: Close on source-level bootstrap proof
options.body: Accept the merged LAN bootstrap persistence repair as sufficient even without proving the exact repeated reapproval loop on device.

recommendation.title: Require live iOS reconnect proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until an iPhone build pairs once, reconnects several times, and gateway status/logs show no new pending reapproval.
